authorization.fresh_recheck: reload actor, session, and permission snapshot; then Evaluator.Create(role)

role_matrix.root: may create role=user|admin; role=root is rejected
role_matrix.administrator_create: requires Root and a valid users.create_admin action ticket

authorization.failure_mode: dependency reads fail closed; frontend capability projection is display-only

headers.Authorization: required Bearer authentication under the existing mechanism
headers.Idempotency-Key: required exactly once; unique original value; format and secret handling follow the admin action foundation

X-Action-Ticket.role=admin: required exactly once; valid users.create_admin ticket bound to the complete intent

body.json_rule: one JSON object; reject unknown fields, duplicate keys, trailing values, and oversized bodies

username.rule: required; NormalizeUsername; permanently unique including soft-delete tombstones; immutable after create

nickname.rule: optional; null or trimmed non-empty value of at most 64 Unicode characters; omitted reads as null

password.rule: required; preserve bytes without trim; existing 8-20 Unicode character and weak-password rules

role.rule: required; root and every other value reject

group_guid.rule: optional/null resolves the current unique active non-deleted default group; explicit value is a canonical positive decimal int64 string for an active visible group

permission_overrides.rule: only role=admin and Root; canonical capability order; no duplicate capability; capability must exist, be grantable, non-Root-only, and available

body.example_secrets: password values are example-only placeholders and must never be used as credentials

operation_ref.rule: non-empty; use for unknown-result operation query

permissions_version.rule: null for role=user; canonical string 1 for role=admin

action_ticket.intent: same normalized business fields, resolved defaults, and validated permission overrides as create; raw password bytes participate in the HMAC and are cleared immediately
action_ticket.consumption: single-use; final create rechecks actor and authorization; ticket cannot freeze prior authority
non_effects: does not generate or reserve a user GUID
action_ticket.secrecy: do not log, persist, or return password text, password hash, length, or fragment

idempotency.request_hmac: covers the normalized complete create intent

same_scope_same_request.active_target: return the exact HMAC-verified original terminal 201 result without another user or audit record

deleted_target.rule: return only the stable safe error and operation_ref after the A14 delete transaction atomically redacts the snapshot; an exact pre-0010 canonical zero-HMAC sentinel for a deleted target also returns this result without reading or returning the old success body

idempotency.lost_response: query the operation with the same scope; never automatically create a new key and replay
idempotency.pre_commit_failure: return a stable error; ticket consumption and operation state use the existing recovery semantics

response_integrity.key: independent response key derived from the action-security root key
response_integrity.target_binding: admin_operation_responses.target_guid is a durable positive target for every new active snapshot; HMAC v1 binds that same value in its backward-compatible result_guid slot
response_integrity.expiry_rule: operation expiry may clear admin_operations.result_guid, but the durable response target remains available for privacy redaction; expired create requests return the stable operation-expired 410 and never expose the stored success body
response_integrity.deletion_lookup: A14 locks every target_guid snapshot and every candidate successful create marker before the user write; post-0010 active and current-key redacted snapshots require an exact marker, operation binding, digest, and HMAC. An exact canonical pre-0010 zero-HMAC sentinel is already PII-free and may be accepted without a matching marker, or re-HMACed by an exact guarded update when the marker is valid, so a misbound marker cannot block an unrelated user. An exact valid marker with a missing snapshot and any active snapshot without its exact marker still fail closed; zero valid markers and zero snapshots means no create snapshot exists
response_integrity.migration: 0010 treats every pre-0010 response snapshot as unverifiable because SQL cannot authenticate the runtime-key HMAC: after optional strict diagnostic target backfill from an exact live create result or exact expired-operation successful ResultUser marker, every active and redacted row is atomically normalized to fixed 201 application/json, canonical {}, its fixed digest, is_deleted=1, and a zero-HMAC sentinel. Mismatched or unresolved targets remain null and no pre-0010 PII or replayable 201 body survives before the final outcome/lifecycle CHECK, target index, and foreign key; only post-0010 writes may create active real-HMAC snapshots
response_integrity.key_rotation: rotation is prohibited while post-0010 response snapshots that may require replay or current-key delete redaction remain active unless a separately approved key-id, multi-key verification, or transactional re-HMAC migration is deployed; canonical pre-0010 zero-HMAC sentinels are already PII-free and do not require an old key, while any unsupported active-snapshot rotation fails closed
response_integrity.tamper_rule: post-0010 active rows and direct target/body/digest/version/lifecycle mutation without a valid HMAC fail closed; an active target paired with a zero-HMAC sentinel is unavailable, while only an exact canonical sentinel whose target is already deleted yields the stable no-PII 410; direct deletion of a post-0010 snapshot is detected by its exact durable marker and fails closed

request.query_rule: exactly one scope query parameter and no other query parameters

headers.Idempotency-Key: required exactly once; unique original value

active_group_directory.authorization: groups.read; callers lacking groups.read may omit group_guid and use the immutable default-group form path without querying this directory

request.query_rule: accept exactly one status=active and no other query parameters

response.result_rule: active, non-deleted, readable groups ordered by key ascending; default must be present

dependency_failure.rule: return when a dependency is unavailable, default is duplicated, or visible group data is corrupt; do not substitute hard-coded choices

active_group_directory.frontend_submit_gate: when groups.read is present, pending, error, empty results, or a selection absent from the current active catalog all disable submit and produce zero create/verify requests; only callers without groups.read use omitted group_guid

transaction.result: user, administrator permission head/overrides, security facts, redacted audit, outbox, operation result, and ticket consumption commit atomically
transaction.rollback: any failure rolls back all listed writes and terminal success state; A14 deletion and create-response redaction/re-HMAC also commit or roll back together

commit_unknown.rule: include operation_ref and require query/recovery; never report success

headers.X-Request-ID: required non-empty on every success and route error
headers.Retry-After: only 429 and is an integer number of seconds

matrix.rule: invalid JSON or fields, username, nickname, password, role, group GUID, plan, override format, amount, or another unknown field
role hierarchy, users.create, or additional capability denied; do not disclose hidden resources
explicit group missing, inactive, or invisible; use one safe response
username conflict reveals only the conflict fact; ticket, actor/session, and policy drift retain existing action codes

operation_expired means the create operation retention ended and exposes no snapshot body; created_user_deleted means a retained successful target was soft-deleted and returns no original target fields or response body
only action not activated server-side or deployment version mismatch
database, Redis, permission, or commit state cannot be safely determined

frontend_security.lifetime: component memory only; clear on close, success, explicit failure, and unmount
frontend_security.conflict_recovery: on username_conflict retain non-sensitive form fields and clear password, ticket, and idempotency key
frontend_security.policy_drift_recovery: refresh current capability and directory data
frontend_security.money: no amount or balance input, query/localStorage mock toggle, ledger, recharge, refund, or deduction

execution_order: before Operation.Begin create two independent owned password byte backing arrays, one exclusively for descriptor encoding and one exclusively for a possible hash; authenticate, enforce action rate limit, role and capability checks, and resolve idempotent terminal replay before Argon2; Begin may clear only its descriptor copy; forbidden, rate-limited, error, and replay requests hash zero times and clear applicable buffers; only ExecutionReady hashes the independent copy exactly once, then clears both plaintext copies and the hash without creating a plaintext password string
audit_outbox: audit action is exactly users.create or users.create_admin and records terminal_state, redacted failure_code, request_id, operation_ref, and successful resource detail; outbox records terminal success/failure plus failure_code; neither persists password, ticket, idempotency key, hash, length, or fragment
